method: For each coast-adjacent land cell, seed a priority-flood minimax spill barrier over eight adjacent land cells. Assign other cells a parent toward the selected coastal root using lexicographic barrier and hop count. This is a synthetic coastal catchment partition, NOT real DEM D8 steepest-slope drainage. Shore distance uses eight-neighbor grid hops.

rainfall_scenarios.coastal_moist: coastal 1.35 linear to inland 0.65 by cell-hop inland depth
rainfall_scenarios.interior_moist: coastal 0.65 linear to inland 1.35 by cell-hop inland depth

qualifications: No physical area, kilometer, precipitation mm or discharge m3/s inferred
B19 outlet-root partition recomputed independently; channels are not the B18 twenty-five marked trial lines
Cell-level basin grouping does not prove a natural inland lake or wetland
No countries or accepted names assigned to H2 cells
Coastline B16 is unchanged; no official geography changed
